name: Master of Winds — you may have base power and toughness become 4/1 or 1/4 is a two-option trigger
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). "Whenever you cast …, you may have this creature's base power and toughness become 4/1 or 1/4 until end of turn" produced nothing: the trigger was fired as one sentence holding both values. extractTriggeredAbilities now offers "become N/N or N/N" as two options (the same pop-up as a modal trigger), each a full sentence without "you may have". Mode 1 (1/4) is fired first, then mode 0 (4/1); the later one wins.
